status.description: The actor's current reading-state status for this target, e.g. wishlist, backlog, in_progress, paused, completed, or abandoned.

progress.description: Optional log of the actor's reading or listening progress over time for this target.

createdAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

startedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix. This records the first instant the actor entered in_progress for the current reading episode. Returns to in_progress within 14 days preserve the same startedAt.

updatedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

finishedAt.description: Canonical UTC instant serialized as ISO 8601 with a trailing Z suffix.

catalogTarget.description: The work and edition that this reading-state record tracks. Mutable.

catalogSnapshot.description: Point-in-time catalog metadata for the tracked work or edition, captured when this record was last written. Refreshed on every update.

catalogTargetCustomization.description: Optional user-confirmed override of catalog totals (page count, chapter count, or audio duration) for this specific target.

main.description: A reading-state record for one edition per actor. Duplicate convention: the rkey is a TID minted once at first create and never changes. Several records may exist for one actor and edition (for example from out-of-band writers); consumers SHOULD treat the record with the greatest `updatedAt` (falling back to `createdAt`) as the winner and break ties by the lowest TID, ignoring the others. This is a convention, not an enforced contract: AppViews MUST tolerate a differing winner, and may see a record's catalogTarget change over time.
